evidence_gaps: Fresh per-attempt Solana and EVM runtime records with timestamps, strategy version, chain, capital weight and final status.
Closed-position realised NET P&L after network/base fees, priority fees, tips, gas, builder/platform fees, slippage, price impact, rent and failed-attempt costs.
Quote-to-submit and submit-to-inclusion latency, quote age, simulation result, RPC errors, reverts, dropped transactions and reconciliation outcomes.
Exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE primary-cause attribution with an UNKNOWN category and ledger reconciliation.
Solana leader-level walk-forward results, selection history, concentration, drawdown and follower-versus-leader return decay.
EVM chain-specific gas bids, gas estimates versus actual gas, failed-transaction gas, transfer-tax behavior and route-level atomic minimum-profit enforcement.
Out-of-sample shadow results by chain, route type and trade size, including profit factor, money-weighted net P&L, tail loss and abstention rate.
At least five current high-resolution execution samples before any infrastructure conclusion, and adequate strategy samples before any profitability, CANARY or LIVE claim.

proposals.downside_risk: A deliberately conservative model may reject real opportunities, especially during temporarily cheap gas or unusually deep liquidity.

evidence.detail: V2/V3 candidates record estimated_gas_base as zero; slippage reserve is gross_profit multiplied by slippage bps, not input capital multiplied by adverse-execution bps.
Conservative net is captured gross minus the scanner-provided gas, builder and slippage fields, so understated scanner costs propagate directly into edge ranking.
Cross-DEX candidates correctly remain disabled and require an atomic executor; preserve this fail-closed treatment.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer false-positive EVM signals and improved money-weighted shadow net P&L by abstaining when complete executable costs consume the quote edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 fresh simulated candidates and 30 executable shadow fills per material EVM chain, spanning at least seven days and multiple gas regimes; report results separately by chain, route type and capital size.
proposals.rationale: Positive quoted gross edge is not positive executable edge. EVM gas, per-hop adverse fill, transfer-tax behavior, quote decay and failed-transaction gas must be charged using chain-specific values before a candidate is ranked.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay fresh wallet-specific V2 and V3 simulations by chain and compare the current model with a model charging estimated gas at the chosen fee bid, input-notional slippage/impact reserve, builder fees and failure-cost expectation. Require positive out-of-sample net P&L and profit factor above 1 after every cost, with no worse tail loss. Stop if any candidate labelled positive has non-positive simulated executable net, required cost data is missing, or failure-adjusted net remains non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Stronger sample and uncertainty requirements reduce frequency and may react slowly to genuinely new profitable leaders.

evidence.detail: Entry estimation uses the minimum of historical and recent arithmetic mean returns, permits five samples, then subtracts Jupiter round-trip loss, fee, two-leg slippage and latency reserves.
The profile includes 25% take profit, 10% stop loss, trailing and break-even rules, but stale evidence provides no realised distribution supporting those thresholds.
Receipts can record network fee, priority fee, tips, impact, slippage and net execution P&L, providing the required basis for cost-complete validation when fresh data exists.

proposals.expected_effect: A more robust abstention policy should reduce capital allocated to leaders whose apparent historical return is driven by outliers or is not reproducible after follower latency and costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed shadow positions, at least 10 leaders, 14 calendar days, five or more observations per leader, and at least 90% complete cost and execution-stage records; also report capital-weighted drawdown and leader concentration.
proposals.rationale: The entry gate is directionally sound but small-sample means are sensitive to skew and leader selection bias. Strategy/market alpha must be validated separately from Jupiter, RPC, signing, simulation and inclusion failures.
proposals.shadow_test: Walk-forward shadow-test the existing estimator against a conservative lower-confidence or winsorised money-weighted estimator. Charge entry and exit quote deterioration, priority/base fees, tips, rent where applicable, failed attempts and realised price impact. Attribute adverse market movement after successful entry as STRATEGY/MARKET and quote/RPC/simulation/signing/inclusion/reconciliation failures as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop if either estimator has non-positive net P&L, profit factor at or below 1, unstable leader concentration, or insufficient cost coverage.

proposals.downside_risk: Incorrect causal rules can create false certainty; UNKNOWN must remain available when telemetry cannot distinguish causes.

evidence.detail: Losses receive overlapping heuristic flags such as FAST_REVERSAL_OR_EXECUTION_COST and MARKET_MOVE_OR_LEADER_SIGNAL_LOSS rather than an exclusive primary cause with cost attribution.
Evaluation aggregates gross profit, gross loss, fees, slippage and net profit, but stale evidence contains no current per-trade causal forensics.
Evidence status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with no generated runtime timestamp.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents replacing a sound signal because of infrastructure faults, or retaining a losing signal by blaming normal market losses on execution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attempted signals per chain family, including successes, safety rejections and failures, with exact reconciliation of fees and realised outcomes; require at least five examples before reporting a failure subtype rate.
proposals.rationale: Strategy changes cannot be evaluated correctly when market losses and infrastructure failures are pooled. Each attempted trade needs one primary cause and optional contributing causes, with failed-attempt costs included in strategy-level money-weighted net P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: Classify every shadow attempt into STRATEGY_MARKET, EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE, SAFETY_REJECTION or UNKNOWN using predeclared observable rules, then reconcile category costs to the complete ledger. Stop if classifications overlap, totals fail to reconcile exactly, or UNKNOWN exceeds 10%; do not infer profitability from classified data until adequate samples exist.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current strategy to CANARY or LIVE.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable, so executable profitability, failure rates and cost coverage cannot be validated.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader selection or exit thresholds for win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores position size and loss magnitude; the objective is money-weighted net P&L after all costs.
The repository correctly marks it shadow-only because non-atomic legs expose the wallet to inventory, reversion and adverse-selection risk.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quoted gross arbitrage as executable profit.
rejected_ideas.reason: Current EVM scanner records omit material gas and under-reserve slippage, while execution failure costs are unknown.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. Safety gates generally fail closed, but profitability and promotion claims are prohibited because runtime forensics are absent. EVM opportunity ranking materially understates executable costs: scanner gas is zero and slippage reserve is calculated from gross profit rather than deployed capital. Solana has a cost-adjusted entry gate, but its leader-return estimator uses only means over as few as five observations and needs out-of-sample, money-weighted validation. Loss forensics also use overlapping heuristic flags rather than an exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE attribution.
